steps.description:
You can run different codes based on different conditions using an IF-ELSE IF block.
Referring to the image below the program will check in this sequence:
  1. It will check from the top. 
  2. If Condition 1 is True, then Code A will run and after running, it will skip the rest of the block.
  3. If Condition 1 is False, it will then check Condition 2. If Condition 2 is True, Code B will run and after running, it will skip the rest of the block.
  4. If Conditions 1 & 2 are False, it will then check Condition 3. If Condition 3 is True, Code C will run and after running, it will skip the rest of the block.
  5. If all the Conditions are False, none of those codes will be run.


You can form an IF-ELSE IF block from an IF block:
  1. Drag out an IF block.
  2. Click on the little blue gear icon.
  3. Drag and join the required blocks to form the following:

  2. Using a Comment block, write down which note(s) (A4, B4, C4) will you hear when ALL the buttons are held down and the program is run.
